preprocessing: exclude counties with missing or nonpositive liability before drawing blocks and determining qn; keep prespecified frozen score values
allocation: fractional top 20 percent of pseudo county rows with ties split; sampled blocks repeat all their county rows
metric: (sum allocation_weight*county_indemnity / sum allocation_weight*county_liability) / (sum county_indemnity / sum county_liability)
inference: post hoc within-event block perturbation; not independent events, not ground truth, not proof of superiority. Mean and range only across draws with all four events defined
